notes.title: Graphics & in-game items update
notes.notes: Hello! We have added new graphics and in-game items for ball's customization. It is free to use, but you must have more than 4 hours in ArcBall. Also we have deleted all achievements in by reason of a limit of 100 achievements and we are going to add new soon.

notes.title: The new version is available!
notes.notes:
The new version is already available!
Bugs fixed and achievements added again.
Enjoy playing with new graphics!
